title: Christoffel symbols from metric
objective: Compute Christoffel symbols Γ^K_{IJ} = (1/2) g^{KL} (∂g_{IL}/∂θ^J + ∂g_{JL}/∂θ^I − ∂g_{IJ}/∂θ^L) symbolically from the metric produced in P2-1.
scope: Add `christoffel_symbols(g_ij, theta)` returning the (3,3,3) symbol array.
Cache the computation — symbolic differentiation of a full metric can be slow.
For Cartesian G (fast path), return zeros directly without differentiation.
implementation_steps: Implement the symbolic formula with SymPy.
Add a fast-path shortcut: if the metric is constant, return zero.
Unit-test against the cylindrical Christoffel symbols (which have known closed forms).
Unit-test that a Cartesian metric returns zero to machine precision.
acceptance_criteria: Cylindrical Christoffel symbols match the hand-calculated values.
Symbolic simplification finishes in < 5 seconds for the cylindrical example.
risks: SymPy simplification can hang on complex metrics. Mitigation: add a timeout and fall back to the un-simplified result.
completion_notes: All 3 gates passed on first attempt. Formula verified against textbook for cylindrical and spherical. Fast path for constant metrics. Performance < 5s.
